records.global_scope: No noise-robust survey-wide false-alarm calibration. Original 1% allowance is conditional and per batch.
records.diagnostic_scope: Refined original candidate profiled across noise models versus each noise-only global maximum across the declared period union; conditional candidate-specific diagnostic. Plug-in finite noise family, not survey-wide FAP.
records.robustness_evidence: The approximately 96-day signal survives individual-day and time checks but falls from Δχ² 41.76 to about 7.21 with broader red-noise coverage.
records.confirmation_evidence: TPA has 91.2% conditional detection power but does not corroborate the waveform (fixed-period Δχ² 1.903; coefficient-contrast p 0.00568). This is informative non-corroboration, not a conclusive exclusion.

records.global_scope: No noise-robust survey-wide false-alarm calibration. Original 1% allowance is conditional and per batch.
records.diagnostic_scope: Refined original candidate profiled across noise models versus each noise-only global maximum across the declared period union; conditional candidate-specific diagnostic. Plug-in finite noise family, not survey-wide FAP.
records.robustness_evidence: The approximately 81.75-day signal survives every day deletion and has compatible early/late coefficients. However, its Δχ² falls from 57.67 to 1.81–2.28 under 32/64-mode red noise. The model-selected comparison retains statistic 25.91, with 0/512 null exceedances, because the preferred signal model returns to the released covariance while the preferred null uses steeper 64-mode noise. This model dependence warrants NOISE_SENSITIVE despite the interesting conditional tail.
records.confirmation_evidence: TPA has only 29.0% conditional detection power and no fixed-period support. That non-detection is underpowered and does not settle the candidate.
